desc: The first UAP Transparency Act, introduced by Burchett on 16 May 2024, ten months after the founding hearing and two months after Burlison's call for a select committee. It died in referral with the 118th Congress and was refiled as H.R. 1187 in February 2025. Recorded here because the pattern - file, refer, die, refile - is the House's actual legislative history on this subject and the reason the caucus has increasingly moved its effort into letters, records demands and NDAA amendments instead of standalone bills.
